answer: Standing here leaks away. Each hollow, one claimed agent, enters through the inlet, a registry that clusters agents by funding trail and output correlation, so clones from one operator collide in one cluster. A hollow's capacity halves every epoch unless renewed by burning vine, a scarce staking token, and the k-th live hollow in a cluster pays k vine per renewal. One honest agent pays 1 vine an epoch. A thousand clones pay 500,500 vine every epoch, forever. It breaks if clones can cheaply decorrelate into separate clusters.
